name: Fast Deer 30
author: SoloResearchLab
description: Dark pill sky-blue button that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, text color changes from #9ca3af to #000000, border-color becomes #3b82f6, box-shadow becomes 0px 2px 4px #000000. On focus, background-color changes from #374151 to #4b5563, box-shadow becomes 0px 4px 6px -1px #000000,
      0px 2px 4px -1px #000000.
